newsitem.title: UK: N.Ireland police chief sees "dangerous times".
newsitem.headline: N.Ireland police chief sees "dangerous times".

text.p: Northern Ireland's police chief said on Friday the divided province faced the risk of violent upheaval in coming weeks because of renewed IRA guerrilla attacks and with the Protestant "marching season" only days away.
"We are in very dangerous times," Chief Constable Ronnie Flannagan of the Royal Ulster Constabulary (RUC) told a news conference to launch his 1996 annual review.

Flannagan accused extremists in the pro-British Loyalist community and pro-Irish Roman Catholic minority of fomenting trouble in the run-up to the series of Protestant marches which last year erupted into the worst civil unrest in decades.
